questions.question: Why is 担仔面 also called 度小月担仔面？

choices.text: It was created by a person named Xiao Yue
It was a celebration food that people ate during the small months
It was a dish that fisherman carried on poles to sell during the small months
choices.explanation: 度小月担仔面 is noodles in a pork and shrimp head broth, with shrimp, chicken, egg, and bean sprouts on top. Also known as 度小月担仔面, which directly translates to “get through the small month noodle on carrying pole”.  Months with frequent typhoons are called “小月”(small month). During these times, it is hard to go out to sea, so fishermen carried noodles on carrying poles and sold noodles for a living during these months. The noodles on a carrying pole helps them get through the small month, giving it the 度小月担仔面 its name.

choices.text: It originated from a ferry crossing called Xiao Yue
